name: Going Slow in Idaho 2022
information:
* Please be sure to familiarize yourself with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
* If you are a first time competitor it is recommended that you watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?app=desktop&v=dPL3eV-A0ww).
* Please make sure to attend the competitor tutorial at 8:30 AM.
* Masks are strongly encouraged to be worn throughout the competition.
